text:
Elaine (SecEng): FYI customer BrightHold sent an SQ with three hard asks: RBAC change to allow read-only cross-tenant for a support role, 18mo audit log retention, and KMS envelope proof/HSM custody questions. Can we sync before the security review call tomorrow?
Mira (Infra): which RBAC change exactly? cross-tenant read-only can be trickier than it sounds.
Elaine (SecEng): they want a scoped support role that can view metadata + metrics across dedicated deployments but not access PII or secrets. They also asked for a sample policy and evidence of least privilege.
Sam (Platform): @Mira we currently have tenant-scoped roles. For cross-tenant view we can add a read-only aggregator role that uses service-account impersonation + read-only query APIs. Need to validate audit hooks.
Nate (SRE): 18 months retention is above our default 90d. We can support via log-archiving pipeline to S3 (customer-owned bucket) + integrity hashes. Need to confirm compliance controls for exported logs (redaction, encryption-at-rest).
Ashley (Customer Success): customer asked if we can provide a signed statement and an example of the export config. Also wants to know whether keys are in their KMS or ours.
Elaine (SecEng): they prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) but asked for an envelope key flow diagram and a short proof-of-possession statement.
Mira (Infra): we support envelope encryption with customer KEKs in KMS (GCP/AWS/Azure). The runtime uses a locally-generated DEK per model instance, wrapped by customer's KEK. We can provide the wrapping metadata and key-id audit trail.
Sam (Platform): sample policy snippet for the aggregator role (very rough):
```
allow: role:cross-tenant-readonly
resources: [deployments/*/metrics, deployments/*/metadata]
actions: [read:list, read:get]
constraints:
  - exclude: secrets, keys, user_data
```
Nate (SRE): for audit retention we should offer two deliverables: 1) signed export manifest with SHA256s, 2) automated transfer job and proof of transfer (S3 object manifest). Ops will keep transfer logs for 30d on our side.
Elaine (SecEng): vuln triage note — customer asked about recent runtime CVE-2025-1234. We patched and rolled out on 2025-06-12; will include CVE CVE-2025-1234 patch notes and mitigation timeline in the packet.
sec-bot: Incident: CVE-2025-1234 - patched in runtime v1.9.4, rollout completed 2025-06-12 03:21 UTC. Reference: https://internal.redwood/incident/1234
Ashley (Customer Success): ok I'll request the formal SQ deadline (they want answers in 48h). Can the sec packet be ready in 36h if we prioritize the export/config snippets + signed statements?
Sam (Platform): I can draft the policy + API examples. @Mira can you confirm the exact KMS metadata fields we can expose (key-id, wrap-alg, key-type) and whether HSM attestation statements exist?
Mira (Infra): we can expose key-id and wrap-alg. HSM attestation: for cloud KMS we can provide attestations where supported (AWS CloudHSM/CloudKMS attestation docs). For on-prem HSM we'll need customer to provide attestation or perform a joint audit.
Nate (SRE): I'll start the log export job template and include the manifest SHA256 command examples. Example: `aws s3 cp /tmp/export.json s3://customer-logs/2025-06-*/ --metadata sha256=<hash>`
Elaine (SecEng): plan: short security packet + export template + policy snippet + CVE timeline. Meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT. Who can join?
Sam (Platform): I can join first 30m.
Mira (Infra): I can join 11-11:45.
Nate (SRE): can do 11:15-12:00, will join for handoff.
Ashley (Customer Success): I'll run the call and collect follow-ups.
Elaine (SecEng): thanks team. I'll assemble the packet and ping for review. /cc @sec-bot for incident link. :thumbsup:
